classification.difficultyReason: Two right triangles share a known height of 7. Find one base with the given angle, and the other base with the angle at the top (tan of the angle at C), then subtract. Several decisions, with no scaffolding.

content.prompt: Find the value of $x$, correct to 1 decimal place.

answer.worked:
Let $L$ be the full base and $s$ the smaller triangle's base.
$$\begin{align*}\tan24^\circ&=\frac{7}{L}\\L\tan24^\circ&=7\\L&=\frac{7}{\tan24^\circ}\\\tan42^\circ&=\frac{s}{7}\\7\tan42^\circ&=s\\x&=L-s\\x&=\frac{7}{\tan24^\circ}-7\tan42^\circ\\x&\approx9.4\end{align*}$$
